title: Test Technician I Full Time - Mexico
teaser: Exciting opportunity for a Test Technician I to play a key role in quality assurance within our manufacturing partner sites. Utilise your technical expertise to troubleshoot and restore critical networking systems, while collaborating with manufacturing leaders. Ideal for candidates with hands-on experience in test engineering or hardware diagnostics in high-volume electronics manufacturing.
description:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

Applications are accepted until further notice. 

Meet the team 

At Cisco, our Supply Chain team is a diverse community of innovators dedicated to delivering value to our customers and partners. We believe our best solutions emerge when every voice is heard and curiosity is encouraged. 

As part of our Regional Supply Chain Operations team, you’ll partner with manufacturing leaders to solve complex challenges and drive digital transformation. We’re looking for someone who brings a unique perspective and a passion for innovation. If you’re ready to grow and make a real impact alongside a supportive, inclusive team, we’d love to meet you. 

Your Impact 

As a Test Technician, you are the heartbeat of our quality assurance process. You’ll be the hands-on expert at our manufacturing partner sites, ensuring our cutting-edge technology meets the high standards our customers expect. 

In this role, you will: 

Solve Complex Challenges: You’ll use your technical expertise to troubleshoot, diagnose, and restore critical networking systems, turning complex problems into seamless solutions. 

Drive Innovation: From prototyping electromechanical systems to refining experimental circuitry, you’ll help bring new ideas to life by designing, building, and testing specialized equipment. 

Collaborate for Quality: Working alongside our manufacturing partners, you’ll use statistical methods and advanced diagnostic tools to analyze performance and ensure every device is performing at its best. 

Grow and Contribute: Whether you’re working from schematics or developing new testing methods, your unique perspective and technical curiosity will directly influence our ability to deliver reliable, world-class technology. 

We’re looking for someone who is ready to jump in, learn, and make a tangible difference. If you’re passionate about technology and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, you’ll find your place here. 

Minimum Qualifications 

A Bachelor's degree (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months).

Qualifying education and work experience should be in test engineering, hardware diagnostics, or a related role within high-volume electronics manufacturing or a related field

Demonstrated knowledge of at least two standard Design for Test (DFT) methodologies and hands-on experience with industry-standard testing tools (e.g., oscilloscopes, signal generators, or automated test software). 

English Proficiency: Capable of expressing ideas clearly and comprehending written texts effectively.

Preferred Skills 

Programming knowledge – OOP and Python would be a bonus. 

Linux/Unix shell scripting. 

Layer 2/3 data networking experience. 

CCNA certification desired, Linux certificate is an advantage. 

DB query experience (SQL, Cassandra, Impala, etc.). 

Why Cisco 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. 

These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Simply put – we power the future. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
